---
title: Playground
description-meta: >-
  Try Panache in your browser: format Quarto and other Markdown flavors with
  live output and configurable formatting options.
image: /images/og.png
format:
  html:
    page-layout: full
    sidebar: false
    toc: false
    body-classes: panache-playground
    css: playground.css
    repo-actions: false
---

Format Quarto and Markdown in real time. Your text stays in your browser. Shared
links include formatting settings only.

```{=html}
<section class="playground-panel" aria-label="Markdown formatter">
  <div class="p-3 p-md-4">
    <div class="playground-options">
      <div>
        <label class="form-label fw-semibold mb-1" for="flavor">Flavor</label>
        <select id="flavor" class="form-select">
          <option value="pandoc">Pandoc</option>
          <option value="quarto" selected>Quarto</option>
          <option value="rmarkdown">R Markdown</option>
          <option value="jupyter">Jupyter</option>
          <option value="gfm">GFM</option>
          <option value="hugo">Hugo</option>
          <option value="vitepress">VitePress</option>
          <option value="common-mark">CommonMark</option>
          <option value="myst">MyST</option>
        </select>
      </div>
      <div>
        <label class="form-label fw-semibold mb-1" for="lw">Line width</label>
        <input id="lw" class="form-control" type="number" min="10" max="200" value="80">
      </div>
      <div>
        <label class="form-label fw-semibold mb-1" for="wrap">Wrap</label>
        <select id="wrap" class="form-select">
          <option value="reflow" selected>Reflow</option>
          <option value="preserve">Preserve</option>
          <option value="sentence">Sentence</option>
        </select>
      </div>
      <div>
        <label class="form-label fw-semibold mb-1" for="line-ending">Line ending</label>
        <select id="line-ending" class="form-select">
          <option value="auto" selected>Auto</option>
          <option value="lf">LF</option>
          <option value="crlf">CRLF</option>
        </select>
      </div>
      <div class="playground-actions">
        <button id="copy-output" class="btn btn-outline-primary" type="button">Copy output</button>
        <button id="reset-input" class="btn btn-outline-secondary" type="button">
          Reset sample
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="playground-options">
      <div>
        <label class="form-label fw-semibold mb-1" for="math">Math</label>
        <select id="math" class="form-select">
          <option value="reflow" selected>Reflow</option>
          <option value="preserve">Preserve lines</option>
          <option value="single-line">Single line</option>
          <option value="verbatim">Verbatim</option>
        </select>
      </div>
      <div class="playground-wide">
        <label class="form-label fw-semibold mb-1" for="math-delimiter-style"
          >Math delimiters</label
        >
        <select id="math-delimiter-style" class="form-select">
          <option value="preserve" selected>Preserve</option>
          <option value="dollars">Dollars ($)</option>
          <option value="backslash">Backslash (\\)</option>
        </select>
      </div>
      <div>
        <label class="form-label fw-semibold mb-1" for="math-indent">Math indent</label>
        <input id="math-indent" class="form-control" type="number" min="0" max="20" value="2">
      </div>
      <div>
        <label class="form-label fw-semibold mb-1" for="tab-stops">Tab stops</label>
        <select id="tab-stops" class="form-select">
          <option value="normalize" selected>Normalize</option>
          <option value="preserve">Preserve</option>
        </select>
      </div>
      <div>
        <label class="form-label fw-semibold mb-1" for="tab-width">Tab width</label>
        <input id="tab-width" class="form-control" type="number" min="1" max="16" value="4">
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="playground-extensions">
      <div>
        <label class="form-label fw-semibold mb-1" for="extensions">Extensions</label>
        <input
          id="extensions"
          class="form-control font-monospace"
          type="text"
          spellcheck="false"
          placeholder="+definition-lists -strikeout"
          aria-describedby="extensions-help"
        >
        <div id="extensions-help" class="form-text">
          Override the flavor's default extensions: <code>+name</code> enables,
          <code>-name</code> disables. Names match the <code>[extensions]</code> config keys.
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="playground-panes">
      <div class="playground-pane">
        <label class="pane-title" for="input">Input</label>
        <textarea
          id="input"
          class="editor"
          placeholder="Paste Quarto or Markdown here..."
        ></textarea>
      </div>
      <div class="playground-pane">
        <label class="pane-title" for="output">Formatted output</label>
        <textarea id="output" class="editor" readonly></textarea>
      </div>
    </div>

    <p id="status" class="status-message mb-0" role="status" aria-live="polite"></p>
  </div>
</section>
<noscript>The playground requires JavaScript and WebAssembly.</noscript>
<script type="module" src="./playground.js"></script>
```
